metadata.description: Marketplace for ColdLineage, a DataHub-native data lifecycle toolkit. Provides the assess-data-temperature skill: range-level archive decisions backed by DataHub lineage, usage, query history and structured properties, with verified execution and writeback.

plugins.name: coldlineage
plugins.description: Governed data tiering for DataHub. Decides whether a date range inside a still-hot table is safe to move to cold storage, proves it against every downstream consumer's actual read window, and writes archive provenance back to the catalog.
